newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Urucu gas project cost put at 1.6 bln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Urucu gas project cost put at 1.6 bln reais.

text.p: Brazil's Urucu-Jurua natural gas project will cost 1.6 billion reais to develop, with state oil firm Petrobras providing 400 million reais of the total, government officials said.
A spokeswoman at the Mines and Energy Ministry also said the remaining 1.2 billion reais in investment would come from the private sector.
Petrobras' investment will be used to build a gas line from the project, deep in the Amazon rainforest, to the town of Coari, Amazonas state.
Urucu, located in the Solimoes River basin in Amazonas state, has proven reserves of 58 billion cubic meters (yards).
According to preliminary ministry data, production at Urucu was expected to begin in 1998.
